"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States needs the cooperation of friends and allies, and should seek the cooperation of Russia and China, in developing realistic strategies to deter and defeat proliferation efforts.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Threats to the United States come from rogue states and terrorist groups, delivered by missile, aircraft, shipping container, or suitcase.",

"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Republicans in the Senate reacted responsibly in rejecting the Comprehensive Test Ban Treaty.",
